title: IGVF Lipids Variant
bodyHtml:
V2F probability scores were generated from Experimental evidence, Functional evidence, GWAS evidence, and QTL evidence for various cell types and tissues by members at Dey Lab of the IGVF Consortium
Phenome-wide association statistics for each variant was contributed by the Associations To Function Knowledge Portal
FAVOR basic information, FAVOR integrated scores, FAVOR basic scores were contributed by Functional Annotation of Variants Online Resource.
